answer: An operator running 53 keys as a result pays for 53 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the ridge salt is published after the inlet checkpoint, the trellis audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 164 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
